title: Vertex AI Claude passthrough: anthropic-beta is filtered per endpoint by vertex_anthropic_betas (unset keeps, empty list drops, list allowlists)
answers: Claude Code requests through a Vertex AI gateway endpoint fail with 400 'Unexpected value(s) for the anthropic-beta header'. How do I stop that?
How do I control which anthropic-beta values are forwarded to Claude on Vertex AI for one endpoint?
Where is the anthropic-beta header handled for Vertex AI passthrough requests?
Does the Gemini or MaaS Vertex path also filter anthropic-beta?
body:
Path: Claude-on-Vertex passthrough and raw proxy requests (the Anthropic messages routes served by the gateway) forward client headers upstream. The chokepoint is mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers, which runs before the shared AnthropicProvider header merge.
Rule: Vertex validates anthropic-beta against the betas it supports and rejects the whole request on one unknown value, while the Anthropic API ignores unknown values. Filter the header per endpoint in the Vertex provider override, not in the shared Anthropic merge. mlflow/gateway/config.py:VertexAIConfig.vertex_anthropic_betas drives it: None forwards the header unchanged, [] drops it, and a non-empty list keeps only the listed values through mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_filter_anthropic_betas (the header is dropped when none remain).
Symptom: Clients that send newer Anthropic beta flags (for example Claude Code's advisor-tool-2026-03-01) got HTTP 400 'Unexpected value(s) ... for the anthropic-beta header' on every request through a Vertex-backed endpoint, so the whole endpoint stopped working.
Constraints: Applies to Claude models on Vertex AI passthrough only. The Gemini and MaaS Vertex providers do not read this option. The filter runs after client auth headers are dropped and only when headers are present. The option is not exposed in the endpoint creation UI; set it in YAML or in the model's auth_config.
applies: Vertex AI Claude passthrough/raw proxy header forwarding in the gateway; not Gemini or MaaS Vertex models.
says: Claude Code crashes with a bad request error when connecting through our gateway endpoint.
AI Gateway endpoints reject requests from coding assistants sending unsupported beta flags.
Allow administrators to configure which beta feature headers are forwarded to Vertex Claude.
Endpoint requests fail with an unexpected header error when clients use preview capabilities.
Filter out unsupported preview headers so developer tools work through Vertex Claude gateway.
search: Vertex AI Claude passthrough and raw proxy requests filter the anthropic-beta header in _VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers using _filter_anthropic_betas driven by VertexAIConfig.vertex_anthropic_betas in mlflow/gateway/config.py. An unset configuration forwards the header unchanged, an empty list drops it, and a list of values allowlists them. This applies only to Claude models on Vertex AI passthrough configured via YAML or auth_config, and does not apply to Gemini or MaaS Vertex providers.
